messages:
anya: quick docs PR to clarify provisioning policy fields and migration notes for autoscale schema changes. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference-docs/pull/4682. need a short SDK and CLI snippet and a one-line migration note.

sam: lgtm. suggest renaming `threshold_pct` -> `target_utilization_pct` and adding migration note: 'old threshold_pct maps to target_utilization_pct; cooldown field renamed to cooldown_seconds'.

marta: add eviction reminder for burst pools: 'Burst pools are preemptible; do not assume latency SLA'. link to eviction model internals.

kevin: SDK example I propose: `client.provision_capacity(tenant="team-koi", pool_type="reserved", policy={"target_utilization_pct":80, "cooldown_seconds":600})`. will add to PR.

anya: include a tiny CLI example too: `redwoodctl capacity apply --tenant team-koi --pool reserved --target 80 --cooldown 600`. keep examples <10 lines per style guide.

docs-bot: Style check: present tense, short examples, include param links. :white_check_mark:

anya: thanks, pushing merge once CI passes and kevin confirms SDK formatting.
